Built Specifically for Texas Solar Operations

We eliminate the friction of scheduling, managing in-house field fleets, and navigating regional Texas utility nuances.

Full ERCOT & Texas Utility Proficiency

Our surveyors understand the exact meter socket, disconnect, and labeling requirements for Oncor, CenterPoint Energy, AEP Texas, CPS Energy, Austin Energy, and TNMP.

One-Touch CAD Deliverables

Every survey delivers standardized photo packages, verified digital pitch readings, rafter spans, and single-line parameters ready for immediate AutoCAD, HelioScope, or Aurora import.

Zero Payroll Overhead & No Travel Fees

Pay on-demand per completed, QA-verified survey. Expand your sales into Dallas, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, or West Texas overnight without hiring regional staff.

Standardized Texas Survey Disciplines

Our surveyors capture every critical physical, electrical, and structural parameter required for solar engineering stamps and municipal AHJ permits.

Roof Geometry & Condition Audit

Physical verification of all roof planes, digital pitch gauge readings, shingle/tile layer counts, granular condition, and millimeter-accurate obstruction coordinates (vents, pipes, skylights).

Electrical MSP & 120% Busbar Rule

Full interior dead-front removal to photograph manufacturer labels, busbar ampacity ratings, main breaker sizes, grounding electrode conductors, and spare breaker slots.

Battery Storage & Gateway Clearances

Specialized energy storage checks verifying NFPA 855 boundaries (3ft from doors/windows), system controller/gateway placement, and continuous conduit routing to the main electrical service.

Photo Documentation Package

High-resolution HD photographs covering 4 exterior building elevations, street access, utility meter context, attic structural ties, and optional FAA Part 107 drone photogrammetry.

How Texas Survey Coordination Works

A friction-free four-stage pipeline connecting your sales intake directly to CAD drafting.

01
Project Intake

Submit Project & Scope

Provide the property address, proposal notes, utility bill, and specific survey scope (roof planes, electrical MSP, battery storage) via our streamlined intake.

02
Local Dispatch

Surveyor Matched & Scheduled

Our operations team coordinates with a vetted local site surveyor equipped with certified safety gear, digital pitch gauges, and multimeters to confirm site access.

03
Field Execution

Comprehensive Field Survey

The surveyor performs an exhaustive on-site audit: complete photo package, MSP dead-front busbar verification, rafter dimensions, pitch measurements, and battery clearances.

04
QA & Release

CAD-Ready Package Delivered

Every photo, measurement, and electrical reading undergoes desk QA verification before release. Your engineering team receives an organized, CAD-ready package.
